fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (single entry)
fees.validity: 3 months validity, stay up to 30 days
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (~60+ countries incl. USA, UK, Canada, Australia, most of Europe)
fees.notes: Fee raised from USD 25 to USD 30 on the official portal effective late April 2026.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (multiple entry)
fees.validity: 6 months validity, each stay up to 30 days
fees.notes: Raised from USD 60 to USD 65 in April 2026.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (tourist, single entry)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (broadly same list as e-visa)
fees.notes: Increased from USD 25 to USD 30 effective 1 March 2026 per Egyptian Travel Agents Association circular; no detailed public government announcement located, so amount not fully verified on an official portal. Payable in cash (USD/EUR/GBP) at bank kiosks before immigration.

fees.name: Embassy tourist visa - single entry (Washington DC schedule)
fees.applies: applicants at Egyptian Embassy Washington DC (US and most other passports)
fees.notes: Multiple entry USD 62. UK, Canadian, Zimbabwean and Nigerian passport holders have different (reciprocity) fee schedules per the embassy. Consular fees vary by mission.

fees.name: Embassy business visa - single entry (Washington DC schedule)
fees.applies: applicants at Egyptian Embassy Washington DC

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visa category exists but no fee published on the embassy page; transit under 6 hours without leaving the airport generally requires no visa. Amount unverified, set to null.

fees.name: Tourist visa via VFS Global India - single entry
fees.applies: applicants in India (Indian and resident nationals; India not on the standard e-visa list, so embassy/VFS route applies)
fees.notes: Multiple entry INR 5,800. Fee includes INR 300 embassy processing fee; VFS logistic fee of INR 800 extra. Amounts corroborated via VFS one-pager references; page blocks automated fetch so treat as medium confidence.

reciprocity_variations.note: Egyptian Embassy Washington DC states UK, Canadian, Zimbabwean and Nigerian passport holders pay different consular fees than the standard USD 27/62 schedule; exact amounts not published on the page, so left null.
Indian applicants apply via VFS Global (single entry INR 2,700, multiple INR 5,800 incl. INR 300 embassy processing fee) rather than the standard e-visa route.

vfs.note: VFS logistic fee INR 800 incl. taxes for all Egypt visa application centres in India, paid cash/card at submission; fees vary by country/centre. BLS International also handles some Egypt visa categories in India.
